definitions.explanation: Caring for animals and protecting them from cruelty; also the movement and the laws that promote this.

examples.japanese: {動物愛護|どうぶつあいご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
{動物愛護|どうぶつあいご}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}した→寄付する：20661_kifusuru⟧。
examples.english: I donated to an animal welfare group.

examples.japanese: {動物愛護週間|どうぶつあいごしゅうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧や⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{譲渡会|じょうとかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: During Animal Welfare Week, adoption events for dogs and cats are held around the country.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動物愛護|どうぶつあいご}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: animal welfare group
- {動物愛護法|どうぶつあいごほう}: the Act on Welfare and Management of Animals
- {動物愛護週間|どうぶつあいごしゅうかん}: Animal Welfare Week (from September 20)

RELATED WORDS:
